question: P and Q can complete a piece of work in 28 days and 35 days, respectively. P begins to do the work and they work alternatively one at a time for one day each. In how many days will the whole work be completed?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total work = LCM(28, 35) = 140 units.

Efficiency: P = 5, Q = 4. Combined work in 2 days (1 cycle) = 9 units.

15 full cycles (30 days) work = 15 × 9 = 135 units.

Remaining 5 units will be done by P on the 31st day in exactly 1 day.

Total time = 30 + 1 = 31 days.

**∴ The correct answer is 31 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Time taken by P to complete the work = 28 days

Time taken by Q to complete the work = 35 days

P begins the work, and they work on alternate days.

**Concept Used:**

Total Work = Efficiency × Time

Total Work = LCM of given days

 
 

 **Person**
 **Days**
 **Total Work**
 **Efficiency**
 
 

 P
 28
 140
 5
 
 

 Q
 35
 4
 
 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Work done in 1st day by P = 5 units

⇒ Work done in 2nd day by Q = 4 units

⇒ Total work done in 2 days = 5 + 4 = 9 units

⇒ Number of such complete 2-day cycles possible for 140 units = 140 ÷ 9 = 15 cycles

⇒ Work done in 15 cycles (15 × 2 = 30 days) = 15 × 9 = 135 units

⇒ Remaining work = 140 − 135 = 5 units

⇒ On the 31st day, it is P's turn again. P can do 5 units of work per day.

⇒ Time taken by P to complete the remaining 5 units = 5 ÷ 5 = 1 day

⇒ Total time taken to complete the whole work = 30 + 1 = 31 days

**∴ The correct answer is 31 days.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Alternate Day Work Concept

When workers operate on alternate days, their combined work over the full cycle (e.g., 2 days for 2 workers) is calculated first. Always evaluate the remainder carefully to check whose turn it is next to finish the remaining fractional work.

Pipes & Cisterns Analogy

Similar to alternate work, pipes functioning on alternate hours use the exact same LCM table format. If an outlet pipe is involved, its efficiency is strictly taken as negative while calculating the cycle capacity.

Work & Wages

Wages are always distributed in the ratio of the actual total work done by each person. If workers work together for the exact same number of days, their wages can be directly distributed in the ratio of their efficiencies.
